name: Xiaomi CyberOne V2
summary: The second-generation CyberOne is a roughly 1.70 m humanoid that Xiaomi trained for about four months on a nut-fastening station at its Beijing EV plant. Xiaomi reports success rising from about 90% to 98%. It is not for sale and Xiaomi has published no spec sheet.
hands: Redesigned bionic hand with human form factor, 150,000-cycle durability and evaporative liquid cooling (March 2026).
highlights: Reached 90.2% success on autonomous nut installation within the line's 76-second cycle time (March 2026).
Success rate rose to about 98% after four months, per Xiaomi at IFA 2026.
Shown at the 2026 World Robot Conference and at IFA Berlin in September 2026.
caveats: Xiaomi has published no price, spec sheet or release date.
